$comment: Initial client JS ratchet for /app routes (gzip -9 KB). Measured 2026-09-27 on main + shell skeleton split. Target from docs/performance/route-budgets.json is 250 KB; lower these as routes get lighter. Enforced by scripts/route-js-budget.mjs in the merge-queue build. 2026-10-02: /app/admin/hud 990 -> 992 after UnifiedTable took the shared column-priority layout; the merge-group build measured 991 KB. 2026-10-04: /app/admin/people 1055 -> 1057 and /app/admin/hud 992 -> 994 after the shared nav learned to hide Identity when the Profiles workspace is off (#20180); merge-group builds measured 1056 and 993 KB. 2026-10-05: restored /app/admin/people 1057 -> 1055 and /app/admin/hud 994 -> 992 after preserving the command palette lazy boundary (#20721); combined head 60a29588989b05173ceef98b577ed353f0013e59 measured 1047 and 973 KB. 2026-10-12: /app/admin/hud 992 -> 995 after main crept back to the ceiling; merge groups for unrelated PRs (#20203, #20970, #20958) measured 993 KB on main b70df22fe0. Lower again once the creep since #20741 is traced (follow-up). 2026-10-12: /app/admin/hud 995 -> 975 and /app/admin/people 1055 -> default 900 after lazy-loading the collapsed HUD noise sections and the non-default People views (#21464); dispatch build b93bd51 measured 965 and 888 KB. 2026-10-13: /app/admin/certifications 900 -> 904 and /app/admin/platform-connections 900 -> 903 after the shell's BrandLogo, Logo and footer moved to the construction geometry from @jovie/ui/brand (JOV-7797, #20570). The geometry object is inlined into four initial chunks per route, which adds 6-7 KB on every shell route. Local builds measured main ece9918d27 at 897/895 KB and the PR merged onto it at 903/902 KB. Follow-up: a mark-only geometry export would recover most of this. 2026-10-12: new /app/admin/inbox route (JOV-6795, #21230) gets 905 KB, matching /app/admin/features; merge-group builds 38248419716 and 38306196113 measured 905 KB. 2026-10-20: /app/admin (Ovie Home, JOV-5959) renders the same page as /app/admin/chat, so it takes that route's 1345 KB budget (PR #22359 measured 1311 KB); /app/admin/ops now renders the Ops dashboard that /app/admin/hud carried and takes its 975 KB budget (measured 942 KB). 2026-11-12 (JOV-8555): per-route ratchet. Every /app route now has its own entry here, written by `node apps/web/scripts/route-js-budget.mjs --next-dir apps/web/.next --write` at measured size plus 2% from the CI mock-env build of main 0b82835e (113 routes; median slack under the old ceilings was 187 KB). A route with no entry fails closed; defaultMaxGzipKb is no longer a fallback, only the most a new route's first entry may be without a raises override. --write only lowers, adds and removes; raising an entry is a hand edit plus an unexpired raises override.
$firstLoadComment: First-load JS gzip (level 9) for app routes outside /app. firstLoad.baselines holds one entry per measured route at measured size plus 2% and is the operative per-route ratchet (JOV-8555): a route with no entry fails closed, and --write only lowers, adds and removes entries. firstLoad.routes, marketingMaxGzipKb and defaultMaxGzipKb are targets: they bound a new route's first baseline (640 marketing, 800 otherwise) and are shown beside each row. Intercepting routes (@auth/(.)signin, (.)signup) are client-navigation JS and are excluded, which is why / dropped from 657 to 567 KB measured on 2026-11-12. Raising any number fails unless raises[key] is an unexpired design-exception-registry gate-weakening override.
$groupsComment: Per-route-group initial-JS ceilings (JOV-8561), gzip -9 KB. Every measured route is attributed to a docs/performance/route-budgets.json group (admin: /app/admin*, dashboard: other /app routes, marketing: firstLoad.marketingRoutes patterns, public: every other first-load route) and must fit that group's baselineKb — never the max ceiling across groups. Each baseline starts at that group's worst committed operative budget, so nothing loosens on adoption: marketing 663 = firstLoad.baselines["/"] (measured 650), public 1309 = firstLoad.baselines["/demo/showcase/[surface]"] (measured 1284), dashboard 1385 = routes["/app/chat"], admin 1345 = routes["/app/admin"]. Targets are the group's initialJS_gzip_kb in route-budgets.json (150/180/250/300); the baselines shrink toward them and deleting a baseline at the target is the goal. Raising a baseline, or a route-budgets.json group target, requires an unexpired raises override (owner, reason, Linear ID, expiry, evidence); lowering is free. 2026-11-12 (JOV-8555): --write lowered each group baseline to its worst per-route baseline: public 1309 -> 1207, marketing 663 -> 578, dashboard 1385 -> 1199, admin 1345 -> 1124.
